meta.title: Prince's Garden (Княжеска градина) – Sofia, Bulgaria
meta.description: Complete travel guide to Prince's Garden in Sofia. Learn about this historic park, including location, features, access, and visitor information.

intro.title: Discover Prince's Garden
intro.description: Prince's Garden (Княжеска градина) is one of the most beautiful and historic parks in Sofia. Located in the heart of the city, it offers a peaceful environment for walking, relaxation, and enjoying nature. The park is known for its rich vegetation, beautiful alleys, and historical significance.

visitGuide.title: Visit Tips
items: Best time to visit is spring and autumn.
The park is perfect for picnics and relaxation.
Don't miss the beautiful flower alleys.

sections.title: History & Creation
sections.content: Prince's Garden was created in the 19th century and is one of the oldest and most beautiful parks in Sofia. It bears its name in honor of Bulgarian statehood and princely history.

sections.title: Location & Features
sections.content: Located in the center of Sofia, at 99A Evlogi i Hristo Georgiev Blvd. The park is easily accessible by public transport and offers spacious alleys for walking.

sections.title: Vegetation & Design
sections.content: The park features diverse vegetation, including old trees, flower beds, and well-maintained alleys. The design combines aesthetics and functionality.

sections.title: Preservation & Management
sections.content: The park is maintained by Sofia Municipality and is a protected zone for recreation and tourism in the center of Sofia.

items.question: What are the opening hours of the park?
items.answer: The park is open to visitors every day, year-round. Daytime visits are recommended.

items.question: Is there an entrance fee?
items.answer: No, entrance to the park is free for all visitors.

items.question: Are pets allowed?
items.answer: Yes, pets are welcome but must be on a leash and under control.

items.question: Is the park accessible for wheelchair users?
items.answer: Yes, the alleys are flat and accessible for wheelchair users and people with reduced mobility.
